correctness.rationale: The exact radial inversion and integration-by-parts formula reduce the problem to an averaged J_1 Bessel tail. Uniform comparison with the unit-disc kernel on the full logarithmic bulk, plus an integrable oscillatory tail beyond the transition scale, isolates the only term of order log(1/delta). The standard J_1 asymptotic and exact periodic mean of |cos|^(4/3) yield the beta-function coefficient. No numerical truncation is used.
